resource.name: vm-cursor
resource.creator: zirmila
resource.category: Fusion, motion graphics, visual effects, and package management
resource.description: Windows screen-capture companion and OFX effect for cursor-following zooms, highlights and keystroke overlays. The plugin requires NVIDIA CUDA; capture can use other hardware. Creator reports Resolve 21 Studio testing but only assumes Free support. Portrait/letterboxed recordings have known positioning limitations.
resource.access: Public download; license terms need review

requirements.dependencies: Windows 10/11 and VM Capture cursor recording
